item.name: Spawn Village and Leaderboard Shoreline
item.landmark: Spawn point, Top Potions List, three leaderboards, Lombart, and Lemin
item.keyContent: Starting village services, material selling, leaderboards, and a nearby shoreline chest
item.relatedFarms: Starter chest route, inventory cleanup, early upgrade planning
item.travelTip: Use the leaderboard platform as the anchor before leaving spawn for the river, bridge, or shop routes.

item.name: Alchemy Table and Refine Machine
item.landmark: Alchemy table behind or near the spawn point
item.keyContent: Potion brewing, material selection, spell unlocks, and potion refinement
item.relatedFarms: All material routes feed back into this station
item.travelTip: Return here after a material loop so you can brew before selling rare ingredients by mistake.

item.name: Roger's Equipment Shop
item.landmark: Roger shop menu with wand, wizard hat, and robe tabs
item.keyContent: Wands, wizard hats, robes, early Attack upgrades, and HP gear
item.relatedFarms: Gold farming, boss prep, gear upgrades
item.travelTip: Check wand upgrades before forcing harder enemy routes, because better damage often saves more time than a risky farm.

item.name: Harryint Wanted Board
item.landmark: Wanted board on the right side of spawn
item.keyContent: Repeatable quests for gold and material rewards
item.relatedFarms: Beginner gold farming, monster quests, material gathering
item.travelTip: Pick a quest before starting a combat route so enemy kills also move your gold and material goals.

item.name: First River Farming Path
item.landmark: River, big rock, tree, and first farming stretch
item.keyContent: Pickaxe Dwarfs, early gathering route, and river rocks chest
item.relatedFarms: Dwarf Emblem, Golden Tooth, early Gold, chest materials
item.travelTip: Run straight from spawn and avoid nearby Pickaxe Dwarfs if you only want the chest or gathering nodes.

item.name: Traveler Camp and Cauldron
item.landmark: Traveler NPC, Cauldron, tent, bridge, and nearby enemies
item.keyContent: Bridge route, tent chest, route split toward beach and mine-side paths
item.relatedFarms: Knife Goblins, Warhammer Dwarfs, chest materials
item.travelTip: Use the Traveler and Cauldron as the reference point before turning toward the lighthouse, treehouse, or mine cluster.

item.name: Mine Entrance and Optimistic Miner
item.landmark: Optimistic Miner, wooden boards, plants, and mine entrance
item.keyContent: Mine chest, miner hint, cave route, and nearby Pickaxe Dwarfs
item.relatedFarms: Chest materials, early dwarf route, mine cluster sweep
item.travelTip: Enter from the boarded mine entrance after the first Pickaxe Dwarf platform instead of trying to force the thorny upper path.

item.name: Secret Mine Cave
item.landmark: Right side of the back wall inside the mine
item.keyContent: Hidden cave extension and secret chest
item.relatedFarms: Chest materials, hidden-route checking
item.travelTip: Open this immediately after the normal mine chest so you do not backtrack into the mine later.

item.name: Mine Mountain Top
item.landmark: Rocks, thorny vines, and upper mine platform
item.keyContent: Top-of-mine chest and high route practice
item.relatedFarms: Chest materials, movement practice
item.travelTip: Use the rocks on the left side of the mine entrance, then follow the thorny vines to the upper platform.

item.name: Goblin Camp Hidden Platform
item.landmark: Bridge rocks, brown pine trees, Knife Goblins, campfire, and rear platform
item.keyContent: Hidden platform chest and bridge-side goblin route
item.relatedFarms: Knife Goblins, chest materials, early hidden-route sweep
item.travelTip: Check the rocks on the right side of the bridge before crossing all the way to the Traveler camp.

item.name: Departure Isle Beach and Portal
item.landmark: Beach route, sea edge, portal area, and Apprentice Broom spot
item.keyContent: Apprentice Broom purchase spot, Warhammer Dwarf and Archer Goblin routes, path toward lighthouse
item.relatedFarms: Flame Crest, Copper Earring, Goblin Finger, Goblin Bone, Dwarf Emblem
item.travelTip: Treat the beach as a connector between mid enemy farming, the lighthouse route, and later travel upgrades.

item.name: Lighthouse Island
item.landmark: Lighthouse, sea, small island, and mountain behind the island
item.keyContent: Lighthouse chest, beach navigation, route anchor for Dwarf King and treehouse checks
item.relatedFarms: Chest materials, Archer Goblins, Warhammer Dwarfs, boss-route travel
item.travelTip: Use the Traveler and Cauldron as a starting reference, then run left past Archer Goblins and Warhammer Dwarfs until the sea opens up.

item.name: Dwarf King Cave and Throne
item.landmark: Dwarf King spawn, hammer wall, chained stone, and cave area
item.keyContent: Boss farming, throne-area chest, Furnace Core route, Flame Crest and Copper Earring drops
item.relatedFarms: Gold, Flame Crest, Copper Earring, Furnace Core
item.travelTip: Farm Dwarf King only after your wand, HP gear, potions, and movement are steady enough for repeat clears.

item.name: Treehouse Branch and Platform
item.landmark: Huge tree, rope climb, treehouse door, railing, and charred branch
item.keyContent: Treehouse chest and Ember Staff Wand purchase route
item.relatedFarms: Chest materials, late Departure Isle wand upgrade
item.travelTip: Tilt the camera upward near the lighthouse route to spot the huge tree before climbing.

item.name: Starting Village Waterfall Cave
item.landmark: Waterfall cave near the starting village
item.keyContent: Ice Star Wand purchase spot
item.relatedFarms: Gold saving, cooldown-focused wand upgrade
item.travelTip: Save the waterfall route for when 20,000 Gold is realistic, because the Ice Star Wand is a late Departure Isle purchase.

item.name: Main Sea of Oblivion Base
item.landmark: Main Sea of Oblivion area, Alchemy station, and Lava Broom spot
item.keyContent: New Mainland hub, Lava Broom purchase spot, Sea of Oblivion material route start
item.relatedFarms: Fern, Sulphur Lumps, Volcanic Rock, orc materials, New Mainland potion targets
item.travelTip: Use the Sea of Oblivion base as the reset point before branching to the enchanting table, lava island, volcano, or lava waterfall.

item.name: Enchanting Table Island
item.landmark: Small island near the main Sea of Oblivion
item.keyContent: Wand enchantment table and Enchanted Stone spending
item.relatedFarms: Enchanted Stones, wand enchantment rolls, Sea of Oblivion power upgrades
item.travelTip: Farm a stack of Enchanted Stones before interacting, because each enchantment roll consumes one stone and the result is random.

item.name: Lava Island and Enchanted Sword Ferns
item.landmark: Lava island with Enchanted Sword Ferns
item.keyContent: Enchanted Stone farming and lava-island material route
item.relatedFarms: Enchanted Stones, Fern, Volcanic Rock, Sulphur Lumps
item.travelTip: Check whether your build can handle the tougher fern enemies before turning this into a long loop.

item.name: Volcano Summit
item.landmark: Top of the Volcano
item.keyContent: Ember Wand purchase spot
item.relatedFarms: 50,000 Gold saving, Sea of Oblivion wand progression
item.travelTip: Treat the volcano route as a late upgrade stop, not an early detour, because Ember Wand costs far more than Departure Isle shop wands.

item.name: Lava Waterfall Base
item.landmark: Fiery lava waterfall next to the Sea of Oblivion base
item.keyContent: Lava Wizard Hat purchase or pickup route
item.relatedFarms: 10,000 Gold saving, lava resistance, New Mainland survival
item.travelTip: Check this route when lava resistance matters, because the Lava Wizard Hat is the only currently tracked hat with that utility.
